scope: Observed-data coarseTopB diagnosis. CPU embedding to CPU B IDs; no token refinement. Whole shuffled paired passes after explicit warmup. Oracle is offline and its build cost excluded only in explicitly cached_oracle times. Instrumented GPU events separate from formal wallclock.
threshold_rules: Common exact coarseTopB threshold: false survivor upper>=cut and exactscore<cut. Separate seed-derived operational threshold included. Exact ties at cut may choose arbitrary IDs; strict-above-cut must never be omitted. Guard4e-4 for all new controls.
gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition
